notes: Images generated with Agnes AI through the visual-director presets, reviewed against the checklist and content-qa. Provenance (prompts, hashes, rounds) is in tools/content-research/media/agnes-log.json. Delivered as WebP (3:2 at 1536x1024, 1:1 at 1024x1024); originals kept outside the repo.

requests.brief: a vegetable seller at an Indian street market weighing tomatoes on a two-pan balance with round iron standard weights in the other pan

alt.en: A smiling vegetable seller at a market stall weighs tomatoes on a two-pan balance, with round iron weights in the other pan.
alt.hi: बाज़ार की दुकान पर मुस्कुराता सब्ज़ी वाला दो पलड़ों वाले तराज़ू पर टमाटर तौल रहा है, दूसरे पलड़े में लोहे के गोल बाट हैं।

requests.brief: a wooden metre scale, a steel vernier calliper and a micrometer screw gauge lying side by side on a school lab bench
must_show: fine tick marks without any numerals

alt.en: A wooden ruler, a steel vernier calliper and a micrometer screw gauge lying side by side on a pale blue surface.
alt.hi: हल्की नीली सतह पर पास-पास रखे लकड़ी का पैमाना, स्टील का वर्नियर कैलिपर और माइक्रोमीटर स्क्रू गेज।

requests.brief: two round archery targets side by side: on the left target the arrow marks are spread widely but scattered evenly all around the central bullseye; on the right target the arrow marks sit in one tight cluster near the outer edge, far from the bullseye
must_show: left: wide spread centred on the bullseye
right: tight cluster far from the bullseye

alt.en: Two archery targets. On the left, many small marks are scattered widely all around the yellow centre. On the right, the marks sit in one tight clump at the outer edge, far from the centre.
alt.hi: दो तीरंदाज़ी लक्ष्य। बाईं ओर बहुत से छोटे निशान पीले केंद्र के चारों ओर दूर-दूर तक बिखरे हैं। दाईं ओर निशान केंद्र से दूर, बाहरी किनारे पर एक सघन गुच्छे में हैं।

requests.brief: a close-up of a pencil lying along a steel ruler, its tip ending between two millimetre tick marks
must_show: the pencil tip lies between two tick marks

alt.en: Close-up of a blue pencil lying along a steel ruler, its tip between two millimetre marks.
alt.hi: स्टील के पैमाने के साथ रखी नीली पेंसिल का निकट दृश्य, उसकी नोक दो मिलीमीटर निशानों के बीच है।

requests.brief: a simple pendulum: a small heavy metal ball hanging from a long thin string tied to a clamp on a lab stand, drawn at rest, with a faint dashed arc showing its swing

alt.en: A simple pendulum: a brass ball hangs at rest on a string from the arm of a blue lab stand, with a dashed curve showing its swing.
alt.hi: सरल लोलक: नीले प्रयोगशाला स्टैंड की भुजा से धागे पर पीतल की गेंद विराम में लटकी है, और एक बिंदुदार वक्र उसका झूलना दिखाता है।
